| NU-020 | `fire_muts_lockstep` — the eligibility gate isolates a cached place: foreign firings emit no mutation on it, the owner's consume phase is exactly one fixed-count matched consume mirrored by the matcher - consume phase modeled per place, produce/inject as mirrored adds<br>`match_cache_lockstep` — incremental match-cache lockstep: under the three-conjunct fast-path eligibility gate of init_match_caches, cache contents equal the from-scratch per-name FIFO recompute of the live ring after any sequence of modeled pool mutations - queue contents only, at one correlated input's granularity; name selection/tie-break not covered<br>`no_reset_is_necessary` — necessity of the never-reset conjunct: a reset arc drains the ring with no cache call - concrete one-sweep desync<br>`one_exactly_is_necessary` — necessity of the One/Exactly conjunct: an AtLeast(1) correlated input consumes count_matching tokens while the fixed-consume matcher pops only the minimum - concrete two-token desync<br>`sole_consumer_is_necessary` — necessity of the sole-consumer conjunct: a rival input arc consumes via ring_remove_first, a path with no cache call - concrete one-firing desync | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ |
| NU-021 | — | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | — |

| NU-030 | — | — | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ |
| NU-040 | — | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ |

| NU-051 | `NU_051_routeA_consume` — AC8, Route A half: a coloured consumer whose timeout forwards another input, or writes a unit token, into a coloured place is refused by the shipped Route A plan | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ |
| NU-052 | `inFlight_guard_is_necessary` — retrodiction of the 2026-09-30 in-flight guard: a pruner whose earlier firing is in flight pre-empts nothing on the Java and TypeScript executors; the prune without the guard drops a firing they perform, the shipped one keeps it - untimed fragment, boolean name layer; the split demand (conflict_demand) that makes inflight:H observable is not modelled<br>`postFixPrune_agrees_with_executor` — the shipped prune condition never contradicts the executor's firing rule (immediate by construction — the condition is the executor's rule); untimed fragment, boolean name layer<br>`willFire_guard_is_necessary` — retrodiction of c23cd9e: the pre-fix conflict-only prune (no will-fire guard) drops a drain firing the executor really performs, the shipped prune does not — nu name layer abstracted to a boolean nameEnabled, untimed fragment | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ |
| NU-053 | `buildPlan_premisesS` — the slot bound of the plan build_plan returns reaches k only through the checker: a returned plan discharges every plan premise of coloured_simulates but ConsumeNoSelfLoop with no hypothesis about the simplex; the coloured set is taken as given, and the NU-054 join refusal is not modelled (it only refuses more)<br>`checkCover_sound` — the checked slot bound: any scaled weighting (Y, D) that the exact re-check check_cover accepts (D >= 1, Y >= 0, Y >= D on every coloured place, Y.C <= 0 on every flat row, k = floor(Y.M0 / D) within the int cap) is a scaled cover at k, whatever the untrusted simplex returned; the simplex is not modelled, and the Rust length check on Y is a shape guard outside the model (it only refuses more)<br>`vacuous_colour_layer_lp` — AC6 for the LP bound: under a scaled cover at k = 0 every coloured place is empty on every marking the flat deposit rows reach, so any sub-net keeping the rows that touch no coloured place reaches exactly the same markings - the zero-slot plan is exact; no H1, reset and consume-all places may carry weight; coloured encoder modelled, not extracted; injection-free (coloured_attempt declines under injection)<br>`covered_place_empty` — AC6, the column side, for the semiflow bound build_plan read before the LP bound: under a covering semi-positive validated law with y.M0 = 0 every positively-weighted (coloured) place is empty on every abstract reachable marking - the zero colour slots the k = 0 plan drops are identically zero (coloured_tokens_le gives the same for the LP bound)<br>`vacuous_colour_layer` — AC6 for the semiflow bound build_plan read before the LP bound (vacuous_colour_layer_lp covers the shipped bound): every flat transition consuming from or producing into a covered place is dead on the reachable set, so any sub-net keeping the untouched rows (what the zero-slot coloured encoding emits) reaches exactly the same markings - the k = 0 plan was exact; coloured encoder modelled, not extracted; injection-free fragment (vacuous_colour_layer_inj is the env-aware twin)<br>`NU_053_ac6` — AC6: a slot-bound optimum below one yields the plan with k = 0: on the exactly(3) fork from one budget token every colour-slot bound that meets NU-053 answers 0<br>`NU_053_ac8` — AC8: with a fork that consumes exactly(3) budget tokens into the two keys, a join that refunds one, and a budget of 7, the optimum is 14/3 and every colour-slot bound that meets NU-053 answers k = 4<br>`NU_053_ac9_reset` — AC9: a reset or consume-all arc on an uncoloured place does not refuse the plan by itself: on mint: budget -> a, b, join: a, b -> budget and cancel: r -> r2 with a reset arc on budget, from {budget: 2, r: 1}, every colour-slot bound that meets NU-053 answers k = 4<br>`NU_053_answers_least` — k is the floor of the optimum and is set: on a flat net small enough that the normative solve reaches no limit, a colour-slot bound that meets NU-053 answers the least certified k whenever it is within 2^31 - 1<br>`NU_053_infeasible` — when no weighting exists (the program is infeasible) the plan is refused (AC4, AC5): a colour-slot bound certified by a covering weighting answers nothing when no scaled cover exists at any k; the fallback itself is the pipeline's<br>`NU_053_le_semiflow` — AC8: k is never larger than the bound of any covering non-negative P-semiflow: an integer covering weighting with y.M0 <= m is a scaled cover at m, so a bound that no cover undercuts is at most m<br>`NU_053_otherRefund` — AC4: a refund to a non-minting place keeps the minting budget a covering weighting, so it stays bounded: every colour-slot bound that meets NU-053 answers k = 1 on mint: budget -> a, relay: a -> a2, r from one budget token<br>`NU_053_relayRefund` — AC4: a relay that refunds and frees a budget token for a (k+1)-th colour leaves the slot-bound program infeasible, so every colour-slot bound that meets NU-053 builds no plan<br>`NU_053_tokens_le` — every reachable marking has the coloured token sum at most y.M0, so at most k live colours: under a bound that meets NU-053 line 1, every marking the flat deposit rows reach holds at most k tokens on the coloured places<br>`NU_053_unique` — the optimum is unique, so every implementation computes the same k (AC8): two colour-slot bounds that are certified by a covering weighting and undercut by none agree wherever both answer<br>`NU_053_zero_exact` — AC6: a bound of k = 0 from a bound that meets NU-053 line 1 gives the exact zero-slot plan: any sub-net keeping the rows that touch no coloured place reaches exactly the markings the full flat net reaches | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ |
